summary: FD_TC_223_3rd Party � Family/Friend � OTP Failed � Upload POA � Manual Handoff
title: 3rd Party � Family/Friend � OTP Failed � Upload POA � Manual Handoff
description:
Validates that when a family member or friend cannot pass OTP authentication, the system requires them to upload proof of authority (POA/authorization document) and routes the case for manual handling.

Prerequisites:
Third-party caller type: Parent/Guardian/Family/Friend. OTP authentication fails (wrong code or passenger unreachable).
